note: Nezu fanghe, vessel A of the museum's set of three (photos 25, 39–45; vessel B = photos 13–16, 24 is never measured here). No dimension is on the label: H 720 mm to the spout lip is INFERRED (the project lead's recollection of 71–73 cm, consistent with the frame, see dossier.md § Scale). Proportions are measured on the side photographs 39 (−X face, ≈ 12° elevated) and 42 (+X face, ≈ 20° elevated) and the flattened faces (faces.json). Axes: front (+Z) = the HANDLE face; the spout leans back over −Z. Parts: lobes (four lobes + legs), body (frieze band + collar), eave (slab), lid (cap, plateau, ridge), spout (tube, flange, peg), handles (the dragon handle with its two horn plates), flanges (every flange), heads (the three small frieze heads).
